objective: תמצא את הקבצים pyproject.toml ו-README.md בפרויקט. תבדוק מה הגרסה שמופיעה ב-pyproject.toml ומה הכותרת הראשית ב-README.md, ואז תסכם לי את שניהם. אל תשנה שום קובץ.

history.text: תמצא את הקבצים pyproject.toml ו-README.md בפרויקט. תבדוק מה הגרסה שמופיעה ב-pyproject.toml ומה הכותרת הראשית ב-README.md, ואז תסכם לי את שניהם. אל תשנה שום קובץ.

NEXUS 1.8 EXECUTION LOOP RESET. Stop patching the existing completion branches incrementally. Preserve the current Understanding, Planner, reconciliation, TaskContract, EvidenceLedger, speed governor, tool execution and failure handling. Rewrite only the normal Director execution/success path around a single explicit state machine: TOOL_CALLS → EXECUTE/RECORD/CONTINUE; NO_TOOL_CALLS → mandatory evaluate_execution_completion; CONTINUE → append focused continuation and loop; PASS + empty final → request final answer and loop; PASS + non-empty final → the only normal success return. No other normal-success return is allowed. task_progress must not return. ExecutionState must not gate success. Add deterministic E2E tests proving all four transitions and statically prove there is exactly one normal success return. Preserve existing failure exits. Run the full regression suite. Do not run a live smoke test until all deterministic execution-loop tests pass. No version bump, commit, tag or publish.

NEXUS 1.8 EXECUTION COMPLETION LOADER RECOVERY.

The execution-loop reset has now exposed the first real failure inside the single completion authority. Do not modify Understanding, Planner, reconciliation, TaskContract, EvidenceLedger, Director tool execution, speed governor, or the new single-authority control-flow architecture.

The exact live failure is:

AGENT_EXCEPTION=TypeError: _load_model_cached() missing 1 required positional argument: 'model_path'

It occurs when the Director reaches the no-tool completion path and evaluate_execution_completion() is invoked.

First inspect nexus/runtime/execution_completion.py, nexus/runtime/understanding.py, and every current call site of _load_model_cached. Determine the exact current loader signature and the canonical way Understanding/Planner obtain local_path. Do not guess the API.

Fix execution_completion.py so it loads the same configured Understanding model through the current canonical loader contract. Preserve caching. Do not introduce a second model configuration mechanism.

Then audit every call from execution_completion.py into shared Understanding generation helpers for API drift, including _load_model_cached, _generate, _generate_final_answer, JSON extraction, tokenizer/model tuple shape, temperature/top_p parameters, and configuration key names. Fix only demonstrated incompatibilities.

Add deterministic regression tests that exercise evaluate_execution_completion() far enough to prove the real loader call shape. Mock the model generation itself, but do not mock _load_model_cached in a way that would hide an incorrect signature. Assert that the configured local_path is passed to the loader.

Also add an integration-level execution-loop test for the critical no-tool path:

tool evidence exists -> Director returns no tool calls -> evaluate_execution_completion is invoked -> CONTINUE loops OR PASS + non-empty final becomes the sole normal success return.

Prove that a completion-evaluator exception becomes a failure and cannot silently become normal completion.

Preserve the current architecture:

TOOL_CALLS -> execute/record/continue

NO_TOOL_CALLS -> mandatory evaluate_execution_completion

CONTINUE -> focused continuation -> loop

PASS + empty final -> request final answer -> loop

PASS + non-empty final -> sole normal success return

task_progress must remain absent from the critical path. ExecutionState must not gate success. Do not restore any second completion gate.

Run targeted tests, then the complete deterministic regression suite. Perform git diff --check.

Do not run a live smoke test. Do not bump version. Do not commit, tag, push, or publish.

Final report must include:

ROOT_CAUSE

LOADER_SIGNATURE

CANONICAL_MODEL_PATH_SOURCE

EXECUTION_COMPLETION_LOADER_FIX

SHARED_API_DRIFT_FOUND

NO_TOOL_COMPLETION_PATH_TEST

COMPLETION_EXCEPTION_FAILS_CLOSED

TASK_PROGRESS_CRITICAL_PATH=NO

SECOND_COMPLETION_GATE=NO

TARGETED_TESTS

FULL_REGRESSION

DIFF_CHECK

LIVE_SMOKE_RUN=NO
